decisions_log.note: Seed locked (driving everything per LO). Fantasy: female PC comes home broke to the house her mother walked out of a year ago; fills the absent-mother vacancy and becomes the matriarch — blood incest (father Roy, brother Wes, sister Maddie), with mother Lynn's Act-2 return as the displacement capstone. Differentiated from existing step-family games (under_one_roof, the_long_summer) and the estate game (the_inheritance): blood incest, absent-mother lever, caretaker->power inner arc. Systems: phone YES, clothing YES, customization YES (default name Cora), rent NO. Title 'Mother's Place' (working).

Step 2 top-level locked. Stats: corruption/money/energy/exhibitionism (4 legs; cut fitness/intelligence/charisma/career; beauty=clothing-derived). Double lock: Cora corruption (door) + per-member trait (Roy relation, Wes relation-via-friction, Maddie own-corruption). Desire ladder W0-W7 (cold start -> woman-of-the-house -> stop-hiding -> take Dad -> Wes power struggle -> groom Maddie -> run the house -> Lynn's return). Economy: bar corruption-ladder + phone pics + Roy's shop; sinks household/clothing/gifts; late pressure = shop foreclosure; rent system OFF. Machine: took_dads_place gates Wes-late; corruption+maddie_clocked_you gate Maddie-grooming; Form 2a economy tissue; DAG holds. Frontier: Lynn capstone -> plateau -> greyed Uncle Gary hook. Fail-state soft+real+recoverable.

Step 2b map locked. Nested-zones, two roots (Home + Town) bridged by a walk activity. 13 locations, all reachable, no door-locks (content gated by traits/flags/occupancy). Home: loc_home hub + cora_room/kitchen/living_room/master_bedroom/garage/maddie_room/bathroom/backyard. Town: loc_town hub + roys_shop/bar/corner_store. Naming: bare nouns for shared/public, possessive for personal (Your Room, Maddie's Room, Roy's Shop). Travel friction: Home<->Town walk costs ~30min+energy (schedules bite), intra-zone free, car fast-travel unlock later. Lynn's Act-2 location + Uncle Gary hook deferred to on-ramps.

Step 3 casting locked. 6 NPCs: Roy (core/foundation conquest, slow-burn tender, roy.corruption+arousal, capstone sets took_dads_place), Wes (core/power-struggle, antagonist->owned rivalry, wes.corruption-via-friction+arousal, late rung gated on took_dads_place), Maddie (core/protege, slow-burn grooming, maddie.corruption raised-by-Cora+arousal, gated on Cora corruption+maddie_clocked_you), Lynn (late pressure+frontier conquest, antagonist displaced-not-seduced, flag-chain, gated on household_is_yours), Vic (corrupting on-ramp+peripheral, leverage/transactional, money/corruption+flags, bar income node Form 2a cold-start), Brenda (light witness, public-exposure fail-state face, cut at blueprint if she doesn't earn). REFINEMENT: family cores use two-meter family spine (npc.corruption odo + npc.arousal throttle), NOT relation (corrected Step-2 sketch). DAG: Roy->took_dads_place->Wes-late; Cora-corr+maddie_clocked_you->Maddie; all-3->household_is_yours->Lynn; Vic no family deps. Uncle Gary deferred frontier hook.

Step 4 story design done (all 4 passes). Player thread: reactive survival want (collapse, stated in opening) + appetite corruption drive from caretaker-power discovery; exhibition backbone bar+house; economy bar/shop/phone with sinks clothes/household/gifts; ceiling = bar backroom; daily routines cook/shower/shift/quiet-hour as fused solo-host+hijack. Briefs: Roy (grief->tender->Lynn's bed, his confession/first-time/took-his-place), Wes (friction->fight-that-flips->break, gated on Roy), Maddie (catch->groom->first-time->share, the made protege), Lynn (return->reckoning->displaced not seduced), Vic (bar on-ramp/backroom income, light), Brenda (light witness/public tooth, cut at blueprint if unearned). World: place jobs+tracks, reactive public (bar predators/town prudes/Brenda schemer), days-not-afternoon cadence, foreclosure->Lynn clock. 5H bathroom CONFIRMED in play (peek/occupied/caught), bedrooms secondary. Reactivity 4A-4F wired in story; pregnancy = designed optional frontier body-state, build-decision deferred to blueprint; fail-state soft+real+recoverable.

Corruption bands 0-24/25-49/50-74/75-100 (Settling In/Stop Hiding/Taking Over/Matriarch); double-lock floors: family tease corr>=25, first-time corr>=50, combined corr>=70 (+ each NPC's own corruption odometer). 11 player feeders (F1-F11), economy bar ladder $25->40->80->200 + phone pics, sinks household-bill/clothing/gifts, Lynn's closet free top-charge.
